<atawi>, one who holds, and the plural <te> written as one word: those who hold or carry something, as a card or a document
<a> and <tawl> written as one word: the one who is tired; <agim atawl> is those who toiled and wore themselves out for a task
<a> and <tawlngak> written as one word: he, she, it or they rest, used before words such as <khit>, <ding> and <hun>
<atawl> with the plural <te>, mostly in the pair {a gim atawlte}: those who are tired and worn out, who toil or suffer hardship
<a> and <tawm>, few, written as one word: few, what is few; {atawm pen} is the least, at least

<atawm>, few, and <atam>, many, said together: a little or a lot, to some degree whatever the amount; placed before the verb it says that a thing happens or is felt to some extent, and {atawm atam cilo in} is without regard to how much
<a>, <tawm>, little, and <man>, price, written as one word: of low price, cheap; {atawmman in} is cheaply
<a> and <tawmpen> written as one word: the least, used before an amount for at least
<atawm> and <penpen> written as one word, placed before an amount: at the very least, no fewer than
<a> and <tawmzaw> written as one word: the lesser or fewer, what is less; of people, the smaller group or minority; {atawmzaw in} is less, to a smaller degree
<a> and <tawng>, here a short piece, written as one word; used in {a neng atawng}, the small bits and pieces, that is the details, and {a neng atawng in}, in detail
<atawng> and <in> written as one word; used in {aneng atawngin}, in every small detail
<a> and <tawntung> written as one word: for all time, forever; often followed by <in> or <a>
<tawntungin>, continually, with the prefix <a> written as one word: for all time, forever
<a> and <tawp> written as one word: the end of something; {atawp dong} is to the end
<a> and <tawp> written as one word: he stops, he gives up doing something
<atawp>, the end, with <dong>, until, written as one word: right to the end; {apatpan atawpdong} is from beginning to end
<a> and <tawpna> written as one word: its end, the end; <atawpna ah> is in the end, finally
<atawpna>, the end, and <ah>, the place marker: at the end; opens a sentence or clause that tells the last event or the last point of a talk or letter
<atawpna>, the end, and <teh>, when: stands at the head of a sentence or clause and tells what happened finally, after everything else
<a> and <tawpsak> written as one word: he or she stopped it, or dismissed someone from a post
<a> and <tawsawn>, urge, written as one word: that urges, what pushes someone on
<ataw>, the bottom, with <vang>, opening, written as one word: the anus

terms: will be cut/to operate on/to cut
definition: <at>, cut, and <ding> written as one word: is to be cut, said of a part of the body that is to be cut off or of a person who is to have an operation
the linking <a> with plural <te> after a word of place or time, those of or the ones at, as {nuai-ate} those below and {nidang-ate} those of former days
<a> and <teek> written as one word: the old, one who is old; {ateek dongin} is until he is old, and {ateek akhang} is old and young alike; with <te> after it, a woman's parents-in-law
<a> and <teeknu> written as one word: her mother-in-law, the mother of the husband, or the mother-in-law as the person spoken of
<a>, her, and <teekpa> written as one word: in the articles the husband of a woman, said of an older couple, as in {nupinu leh ateekpa}, the woman and her husband
<a>, her, and <teekte> written as one word: a married woman's father-in-law and mother-in-law, the parents and household of her husband
<a> and <teel> written as one word: he chooses, or the one that he has chosen
<a> and <teelding> written as one word: what he or she is to choose, or in order to choose
<a> and <teelkhiat> written as one word: he or they chose, or the one that was chosen; {ateelkhiat munpen} is the place they chose
<a>, his or her, and <teen>, clothing, written as one word in the pair {asilh leh ateen}: what he or she wears
<a> and <teen>, a form of <teng>, dwell, written as one word; {ateen huai lo} is not fit to live in
<a> and <teeng> written as one word: he or she lives in a place, or one who lives there, a resident of the place named before it
<a>, <teeng>, live, and <kha> written as one word: who lives or happens to live in the place named before it
<a>, <teeng>, live, and <khat>, one, written as one word: one who lives in the place named before it, a resident of
<a> and <teengte> written as one word: the people who live in the place named before it
<a> and <teenna> written as one word: the place where he, she or they live; after a noun, the place inhabited by those people
<a> and <teep>, suck, here smoke tobacco, written as one word: he or she smokes, or the one who smokes; {za ateep} is one who smokes tobacco
<a> with <teh>, leaf, written as one word: the leaf or leaves of a tree or plant
<a> and <tehna>, measure, written as one word: the thing by which something is measured or tested
quick and clever in mind and speech, said of a person and named together with <apil>, wise; {atei mahmah khat} is a very sharp person
<a> and <teek> written as one word with a short vowel: the old; {atek amoi} is old and young alike
<a> and <tel> written as one word: he or she understands, or the one who understands; {atel baih} is easy to understand
<a> and <teel> written as one word, with the vowel written short: he, she or they chose
<a> and <telcian> written as one word: he understands it clearly; also the one who understands well
<a> and <telnop> written as one word: what is easy to understand; {atelnop dingin} is to make it easy to understand
<a> and <telsiam> written as one word: he, she or they understand rightly; {atelsiam dingin} is so that one may understand
<atel> in its meaning choose, with the plural <te>: those whom the people chose, as the members of a town committee
<a> and <tembaw> written as one word: his, her or their ship or boat
<a>, his or her, and <temta>, knife, written as one word
<a> and <ten> written as one word: he or they live or settle, the time or place of living there
<a> with the plural <te> and the subject marker <in> written as one word: those ones, the people of the place or group just named, as the subject
<a> and <teng> written as one word, placed after a place: who lives there, as in {US ateng Zomite}, the Zomi who live in the US
{a teng} written as one word after a noun or phrase: all of it, all of them, as in {anuai ateng}, all of the following
<a> and <tengte> written as one word: the people who live in the place named
<a> and <tenpih> written as one word: he marries her, the one who marries, or the marrying
<a> and <tep> written as one word, here <tep> in the sense of draw in with the mouth: who smokes tobacco or a drug, or who sucks at the breast, as in {nawi atep}; compare <zatep>
name of two men, the ancestor of a family that returned from the exile and a leader who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah
<a>, his, her or their, and <tha>, strength, written as one word; {atha nem} is weak and {atha hat} is strong
<a> and <thah> written as one word: his or their killing of someone; {athah laitak} is while killing
<a> and <thahat> written as one word: strong, the one that is strong
<a> and <thahkhit> written as one word, before <ciangin>: after he or she has killed someone
<a> and <thahlup> written as one word: he or she killed; before a noun, the one who was killed
<a> and <thahlupna>, killing, written as one word: the act in which he or she killed someone; before <mun> or <Video>, the place or the video of the killing
<a> and <thahlupsawm> written as one word: he tried to kill, the one who tried to kill, an attempt to kill
<a> and <thahna> written as one word: the killing that he did, his killing of someone
<a> and <thahsawm> written as one word: the one who plotted to kill, who tried to kill
son of Uzziah, a descendant of Judah who lived in Jerusalem after the exile
<thak>, new, with the prefix <a>, that which is new, the new one; paired with <alui>, the old
a town in Judah to which David sent a share of the plunder
<a> and <thakin>, anew, written as one word: once more, in a new way
<athak>, new, and <khat>, one, written as one word and placed after a noun: a new one, as {mawtaw athakkhat}, a new car
<athak>, new, and <pen> written as one word after a noun: the newest or latest one, or the new one as the thing spoken about
queen of Judah, mother of King Ahaziah, who seized the throne; also the name of two men
<a>, his or their, and <Thalloh> written as one word: the holder of the position <Thalloh> of that household; the next page writes {a thalloh}
{a than} written as one word, from <minthan>, be famous: it is famous, it is renowned, said of a name; compare <minthang>

terms: his strength/her strength/the strength one has
definition: <a>, his or her, and <thaneih>, the strength one has, written as one word; {athaneih sunsun tawh} is with what little strength she has
<a> and <thanem> written as one word: weak, the weak one
<a> with a verb meaning be famed or spread abroad, not <thang>, trap, written as one word before the person or thing: that is known and spoken of everywhere
<a> and <thapia>, encourage, written as one word: the one who supports or encourages, those who back someone
place in the Negev on the road by which Israel approached Canaan
<a> and <that> written as one word: the one who killed, placed before the person or the number of persons, as in {athat mi}, the killer

terms: the one to kill/the supposed killer
definition: <a> and <thatding> written as one word: the one who is to kill, or who is thought to have killed; {athatding in aki ummawh} is suspected of being the killer
<a> and <thatlum> written as one word: he killed, the one who killed
<athatlum> and <pa>, man, written as one word: the man who killed the person or animal named before it
<athat> and <pa> written as one word: the man who killed, the killer
<athat>, the one who killed, with the plural <te>, written as one word: the persons who killed someone
<thau>, fat, written together with <a>, its: the fat of an animal brought as an offering

<thau>, gun, written together with <a>, his or their: the gun someone carries; the words around it show this, as <thautawipa>, gunman, <laksak>, take away, and <kap>, shoot, not the fat of the first sense
<thau>, be fat, with <a> before it: the fat one, said of people and paired with <agol>, the big one
<a> and <thaulua> written as one word: one that is very fat, also of food that is too fatty
<a>, his or her, with {thau puak}, gun carried, written as one word: the gun a person has on him

terms: the gun he carried/his weapon in hand
definition: <a>, <thau>, gun, and <tawi>, hold, written as one word: the gun that the person was holding
<athau>, the fat one, and <vallua>, excessive, written as one word: those who are too fat
<athau>, his gun, and <zat>, use, written as one word: the gun that someone used in a shooting
<a> and <thawh> written as one word: he or she gets up, his rising; {athawh ciangin} is when he got up

terms: he rises again/he gets up again
definition: <a> and <thawhkik> written as one word: he gets up again, he rises from death
<a> and <thawl>, bottle, written as one word: the bottle of a drink or other liquid; {athawl tawh zuak} is sell by the bottle
<a> and <thei> written as one word: the one who knows, those who know; {athei nailo te} is those who do not yet know

terms: one who knows well/one who knows for certain
definition: <a>, <thei>, know, and <cian>, clearly, written as one word: the one who knows a matter well or exactly; with <te> those who know
<a> and <theih>, know, written as one word: {atheih ciangin} is when he or she learned of it, and {atheih huai thu} is a thing worth knowing
<a> and <theihcian> written as one word: he, she or they know it clearly; {atheihcian nadingin} is so that they may know it well
<atheih>, he or she knows, and <ciang>, when, written as one word: when he or she came to know of it
<a> and <theihding> written as one word: that he, she or they should know, so that they may know
<a> and <theihhuai> written as one word: that which is worth knowing, common in headlines
<a> and <theihkhak>, come to know, written as one word: he, she or they came to know of it
<a> and <theihkhiat> written as one word: he, she or they found out, what was found out
<a>, <theih> and <loh> written as one word: that he does not know, what is not known; {atheihloh kaalin} is while one is unaware
<a> and <theihna> written as one word: his or their knowledge, what he knows; {atheihna ding} is so that they may know
<a> and <theihnop> written as one word: that he, she or they want to know; {atheihnop dotna} is a question they want answered

terms: as soon as he knew/the moment they learned
definition: <atheih>, he knows, with <phet>, as soon as, written as one word and followed by <in> or <un>: the moment he or they came to know of it
<a> and <theihpih>, know together with, written as one word: he or she knows of and acknowledges a matter, the one who is witness to it
<a> and <theihsa> written as one word: what he or they already know, already known to them
<a> and <theikha> written as one word: one who happens to know of it, anyone who knows

terms: already know/the one who already knows
definition: <a> and <theikhin> written as one word: he or they already know, or the one who already knows
<a>, <thei>, know, and <lo>, not, written as one word: does not know, or one who does not know
<atheilo>, one who does not know, with the plural <te>: the people who do not know something
<a> and <theinuam> written as one word: the one who wants to know; {atheinuam te} is those who want to know
<athei>, the one who knows, with <peuh>, any, written as one word: anyone at all who knows
<athei>, the one who knows, with the plural <te>, written as one word: those who know about a matter, mostly as {atheite'n}, asked to tell or write what they know
<a> and <them> written as one word: its pieces, the small broken bits of something
<athem>, its pieces, and <nen>, small or fine, written as one word: the small broken bits of something that has been smashed or blown up
<a>, <them> and <neng> written as one word: the small broken pieces of something, as the wreckage of an aeroplane or the splinters of a blast
chief city of Greece, where Paul spoke at the Areopagus
descendant of Bebai who had married a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
<a> and <tho> written as one word: he rises, he gets up, the one who has risen
<a> with <thoh>, a Burmese loan, take out or issue: withdraw money from a bank, or issue an order, a warrant or a curfew
<a> and <thong>, prison, written as one word: the prison sentence of the one spoken of, as in {athong kiatding}, the term he is to serve
<a> and <thongkiat> written as one word: his or her being in prison; {athongkiat zahding} is the length of the prison term
<a>, <thongkiat> and <ding> written as one word: that he or she is to be in prison; {athongkiatding akum} is the years to be served
<a> and <thu> written as one word: the matter in question, its facts or content

<athu>, the matter, and <akician>, exact: the exact facts or full details of a matter; mostly followed by <in>, {athu akician in}, in detail, exactly, before a verb of telling, announcing or finding out

terms: further details/the fuller facts/in more detail
definition: <athu>, the facts of the matter, and <akicianzaw>, the more exact: the fuller or more certain facts of a report; nearly always followed by <in> and a verb of learning or looking into, {athu akicianzaw in}, in more detail, the closing formula of a news report
<athu>, the matter, and <akigenna>, what is said: followed by <ah>, it opens a news sentence that tells what has been reported about an event

terms: reportedly/according to reports/as the story goes
definition: <athu>, the matter, <akigenna>, what is told, and <ah>, in: in what is told of the matter. A formula of news writing that opens a sentence and marks what follows as reported by others, not as the knowledge of the writer; the sentence often ends in {kici hi}, it is said

terms: the details/the facts of the matter/the particulars
definition: <athu>, the matter, and {a la}, its song, written as one word and not the exclamation: the pair {thu leh la}, word and song, means the whole of a matter, so {athu ala} is all the details of what happened; in news reports the object of <kancian>, investigate
<a> and <thuah>, put on over or in addition, written as one word: he wears or the one wearing, said of a mask and other things put on the body
<a> and <thuah>, in addition, written as one word: do one thing along with another, add one thing to another
<athuah> and <dan> written as one word: how a thing is put on or fitted, the way of wearing or installing it

<a> and <thuak> written as one word: who suffers or bears something; after a verb form it names the person to whom the thing was done, as <mat athuak>, the one arrested, and {zuak athuak}, the one who was sold
<a>, <thuak>, undergo, and <ding>, will, written as one word: that he or she will undergo, the punishment or trial that awaits someone
<a> and <thuakkha> written as one word: the one who has suffered something, a victim; with <te>, the victims

terms: suffer badly/be hard hit/find hard to bear
definition: <a> and <thuaklah> written as one word: who suffers much from something, or what is hard to bear
<a> and <thuaklawh> written as one word: he or they had to suffer it, the one who was hit by the harm
<a> and <thuakna> written as one word: what he or they suffer or go through, the suffering borne
<athuak> and <ngei> written as one word: who has at some time suffered or undergone something

terms: female victim/the woman who suffered it
definition: <a>, <thuak>, suffer, and <nu>, woman, written as one word: the woman to whom the thing named before it was done
<a> and <thuakpa> written as one word, placed after the word for what was done: the man to whom it was done, as in {mat athuakpa}, the man who was arrested
grammar term: the one that undergoes the action of the verb, the object of a sentence, also called <thuakna>; put first with <pen> to make the passive; also written <a thuakpa>
<a>, <thuak>, undergo, and the topic marker <pen> written as one word, placed after the word for what was done: the one to whom it was done, as the topic of the sentence
<a> and <thuaksak> written as one word: made someone undergo something, such as a punishment named before it

<a> and <thuakte> written as one word, placed after what was suffered: those who underwent it, as in {kapliam athuakte}, those wounded by shooting, and {hih natna athuakte}, those who have this disease
<a> and <thuak>, suffer, with <zawh>, after, written as one word: after he or she has suffered it, often followed by a length of time
<a> and <thuakzo> written as one word: he or she endures, the one who is able to bear it
<a>, his or her, and <thugen>, written as one word: what a person says or said, a speech or sermon; {athugen ding} is what he is going to speak about
<a>, his or her, and <thugenna>, speech, written as one word
<a>, <thugen> and the plural <te> written as one word: the things that he said
<a> and <thuh>, sign, written as one word: he or she signs, as in {min athuh}, signs his name
<a> and <thuhilh> written as one word: he teaches or preaches, what he teaches; also said of correcting children
<a> and <thuk>, deep, written as one word: deep, that is deep; after a measure it says how deep, as {pi 20 athuk}, twenty feet deep
<a> and <thuk>, sour, written as one word: sour, that which is sour
<a> and <thukhual> written as one word: one who has regard for others, considerate and well-mannered
<a> and <thukhun>, rule, written as one word: its or their rules
<a> and <thukim> written as one word: he or they agree, or those who agree
<a> and <thukimlo> written as one word: the one or ones who do not agree, the votes against
<a> and <thukkik> written as one word: he or she pays back or does something in return
<a> and <thukna>, depth, written as one word: its depth, the deep part; before a measure it says how deep, as {athukna Pi 14}, at a depth of 14 feet
<athuk>, deep, with <suk>, downward, written as one word: after a measure it says how far down a drop or a pit goes
<a> and <thulu> written as one word: the title or topic of a writing or talk
<a> and <thum>, three, written as one word: <athum un> is all three of them, {athum veina} is the third time
<a> and <thum>, plead, written as one word: he begs or pleads

terms: all three of them/the three together
definition: {a thum}, the three, and <un>, the plural marker: all three of the persons just spoken of, standing before the statement about them; in the same way {anih un}, both of them
<a> and <thuman> written as one word: what is true, the truth, or one who is honest and upright
<a> and <thumanlo> written as one word before a noun: that is dishonest or against the law; {athumanlo in} is illegally
<a> and <thumna> written as one word: the third one, or thirdly in a list of points
<a> and <thumveina> written as one word: the third time, the third in a series
<a> and <thun> written as one word: he or she puts something in, as a ball into the goal or money into an account; {athun nuamte} are those who want to put in
<a> and <thuneihna> written as one word: his, her, its or their authority or power

terms: person in charge/highest authority/most powerful person
definition: <a>, {thunei}, one who holds authority, and <pen>, most, written as one word: the one with the most authority over a matter or in a country; compare <thuneipa>
<a> and <thunget> written as one word: the thing he or she has asked for in prayer
<athu>, the matter, and the topic marker <pen> written as one word: the matter, as the thing spoken about; as for the case
<a> and <thupha> written as one word: his blessing, said of the blessing of God
<a> and <thupi> written as one word: important, the important one; {athupi pen} is the most important
<a> and <thupiang>, event, written as one word: the thing that happened, the facts of an incident; {athupiang teng} is all that happened
<athupiang>, what happened, with <zia>, manner, written as one word: the way an incident came about; {athupiangzia ahihleh} opens the account, as for how it happened
<a> and <thupipen> written as one word: the most important, the most important thing
<a> and <thupisak> written as one word: he or they value highly, or the one who holds something to be important
<a> joined to <thupit>, the form of <thupi> used before endings: its being important; {athupit na} is its importance, {athupit zawkna} its being more important
<a> and <thupitna> written as one word: its importance, the importance of what is named before it
<athupit> and <zia>, way, written as one word: the importance of something, how important it is
<a> and <thupizaw> written as one word: more important, the more important one
<a> and <thusim> in its noun sense written as one word: his, her or their secret
<a> and <thusim> in its verb sense written as one word: he regards, the one who pays regard; {athusim lo} is he disregards
<athu>, the matter, with the plural <te>, written as one word: the things said or written about it, its contents

terms: the whole matter/all the facts/the full story
definition: <a> and <thuteng> written as one word: all of the matter, everything about what happened
<a> and <thuuk> written as one word: deep, said of language, thought or writing
<at>, reap or cut, with the linking ending <in>, used before a following verb; {ki-atin} is being cut or circumcised
<at>, cut, with <khia>, out or off: cut a part off or away
<at>, cut, with <khiat>, off or away; the form of <atkhia> used before <sak>, <manin> and similar words
<at>, cut, and <khiat>, off, with <sak>: cut a part off something that belongs to another, as the corner of a robe
<at>, cut, with <khiat>, off, <sak>, do to someone, and the suffix <in>: cutting a part off a person
<atkhiatsak>, cut off, with the noun suffix <na>: the cutting off of a part, here of garments
<at>, write, with <kik>, again: write something out a second time
<at>, cut, and <kul>, must, written as one word: it has to be cut, of a part of the body in an operation or in circumcision
city in the state of Georgia in the United States
the Atlantic Ocean, usually written {Atlantic tuipi}; also part of English names
machine of a bank from which money is taken out with a card; the English abbreviation used as a noun
noun of <at>, cut; {vun atna}, cutting of the skin, is circumcision
noun of <at>, reap: the reaping of what someone has sown
noun of <at> in its meaning write: the act of writing or what someone has written, mostly after <lai> as {lai atna}; {ki atna} is the way something is written
in {ki atna}, the cutting open of a patient by a surgeon, and the place on the body that was cut; unlike {vun atna}, circumcision
<at>, cut, with <nen>, fine: cut something up into small pieces
<a> and <to>, up, written as one word; in {a suk ato}, the downs and the ups; in the articles also the abbreviation ATO of an office
<a> and <toktok> written as one word: stir again and again, as food with a stick, or keep poking and tapping at a thing, as a child at a phone
a big male rat that lives alone, apart from the others; the book explains it as {zusa a pa gol a tangtente}
<a> and <tolhkhia> written as one word: it slid off or came sliding down, said of a roof or of earth in a landslide
<a> and <tom>, short, written as one word: what is short; {atom in} is in short, briefly, and {atom thei pen} is as briefly as possible
<a> and <tomin> written as one word: in short, in few words; also said of a short form of a name
<a> and <tomkim>, brief, written as one word: the short and complete account of a matter, used in headings; {atomkim in} is in short
<a> written as one word with the verb for wrinkle or shrink, which is spelled like <ton>: wrinkled, of skin, or creased, of cloth
<a> and <ton>, accompany, written as one word: who goes together with someone
<a> and <tonkhawm> written as one word: they go or went along together
<a> and <tonpih> written as one word: he takes someone along with him, he goes with someone
<a> and <top>, pick up, written as one word: he or she gathers up what is left; in English headlines the same letters are the English word atop
first part of <Atoroth-shofan>, a town built up by the Gadites
town east of the Jordan built up by the Gadites
<a> and <tot>, walk along, written as one word: that he walks, the way they travel; {atot ding lampi} is the path to be walked
